Package httyd.battle

Class AttackContext

java.lang.Object
httyd.battle.AttackContext
public class AttackContext extends Object
All information about one attack in progress. Move effects read and change it, which lets a Pierce or Critical effect modify the damage without the engine knowing the effect.
